title: Session Trace-Linker: low-overhead log synthesis and correlation propagation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: produce compact, session-level log records by synthesizing and stitching high-cardinality microservice logs into lightweight session documents suitable for Loki and Elasticsearch ingestion. The service (session-trace-linker) must: 1) attach a stable session fingerprint to logs without increasing cardinality; 2) probabilistically stitch traces when full trace context is missing; 3) enrich logs with span-anchor references from OTEL trace hooks; 4) emit a compact JSON/NDJSON payload that downstream Loki/ELK pipelines can index efficiently. Motivation: many customer incidents show diagnostics require joining many ephemeral logs across services; current workflows either rely on expensive full-trace sampling or manual correlation. This ticket implements an intermediate, production-safe synthesis layer to improve root-cause lead time while bounding cost.
success_criteria: 1) End-to-end latency of the linker add <2ms p50 per log at 10k rps; 2) Storage overhead <10% on average for enriched logs versus raw logs due to compact payload design; 3) Ability to match 90% of sampled traces to session documents in canary workloads; 4) No increased alert noise from high-cardinality fields in production dashboards after rollout.
design_decisions: Use a two-tier sesh-fingerprint: short stable prefix (16-bit) + opaque burst token (32-bit) to avoid explosion of index terms
Probabilistic stitching uses Bloom-filtered span fingerprints sampled at 1% by default with adaptive ramp-up based on error budgets
Enrichment uses OTEL trace hooks to attach span anchors (trace_id, span_id) when present; linker will not create guaranteed trace ids if absent
Output schema v1 will be a flat NDJSON with fields: ts, service, level, msg, sesh_fp, sesh_token, span_anchor_opt, sample_flags, meta_keys (map encoded as comma list)
Backpressure: when downstream write queue >75%, linker switches to header-only enrichment (sesh_fp only) and emits a metric
tasks: Prototype sesh-fingerprint generator and collision tester (unit tests)
Implement OTEL hook integration in runtime-sidecar and runtime agent
Add Bloom filter exporter and compact proto encoder for NDJSON payloads
Write Loki and Elastic ingest adapter transforms (groks / ingest pipeline)
Create canary config and autoswitch policy for adaptive sampling
Add per-tenant feature flag and rollout toggle in Console
End-to-end performance tests and storage cost projection runbook
Docs: design doc, ops runbook, dashboard playbook
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal canary in staging traffic across 3 services (2 weeks)
Beta: enable for 5 low-risk tenants with observability-metrics enabled (2 weeks)
Gradual: ramp to 25% of tenants with automated rollback on error budget breach (4 weeks)
GA: wide rollout with opt-out flag for Dedicated/Private customers
telemetry: Trace: sampled trace spanning hook -> linker -> downstream ingest
Log: linker.warning when downstream queue high and when collision threshold exceeded
testing: Unit: fingerprint collision simulator with synthetic keyspace
Perf: 10k rps runner with 99th percentile < 10ms for entire enrichment step
Integration: verify Loki/Elastic ingest pipelines index session documents and dashboards render correctly
Chaos: simulate dropped OTEL headers and verify probabilistic stitching recovers sessions
